findings.text: §8 lists `IMAS_ALAMBIC_MAP_PATH` (level 2) and the home-derived default `$IMAS_ALAMBIC_HOME/maps/current` (level 3) as the sources for the maps, but the file that owns map-path resolution is `discover_bundles` at `packages/imas-alambic/src/imas_alambic/machine_map.py:182`-`222`, which reads `IMAS_ALAMBIC_MAP_PATH` itself and is the sole consumer of the search root; §8 names `resolve_description_store_root` (for the retired cache key) but never names `discover_bundles` for the map default, so the new facility default can be resolved in parallel to the owner rather than fed into it

findings.text: §9 introduces a bundle-level `"layout": "flat"` (with vocabulary flat/multi-machine) while the codebase already carries a layout mechanism for the same description store: the `description_store_layout` field at machine_map.py:1121, its vocabulary `_DESCRIPTION_STORE_LAYOUTS = {"per-shot", "static-over-map"}` at machine_map.py:36, and its consumer at packages/imas-alambic/src/imas_alambic/pulse_mint.py:144; §9 says the resolvers "read either layout" but does not state why the existing `description_store_layout` cannot carry the flat/multi-machine distinction, nor how the two axes compose when a flat bundle declares a store root
